domain: Philosophy of Measurement / Epistemology / Formal Systems
topic_summary: Deferential Realism v8.0 is a philosophical framework with a working Prolog/Python engine for classifying constraints (rules, arrangements, structures that bind people). It holds that constraints have objective structural properties (extractiveness, suppression, coordination) but that classification depends irreducibly on observer position. v8 introduces a three-term ontology: seat (the one content-position audited against), gauge (positions over that content), and orientation (holder's relation to the seat). The framework measures perspectival fracture rather than resolving it, treating disagreement as signal rather than defect.

key_entities: Deferential Realism framework (measurement apparatus for constraint classification)
Prolog/Python engine (125 Prolog modules, 120 Python scripts as of 2026-07-02)
Observer axis (four canonical positions: powerless, moderate, institutional, analytical)
Committer axis (kernel/reading/axiom/drift structure for contested commitments)
LLM-authored corpus (reset 2026-06-05; small working set plus archived pre-reset corpora)
UKE protocol suite (Universal Knowledge Evaluator; generation pipeline)
Axiom 2 (power reduces experienced extraction: χ = ε × f(d) × σ(S))
Axiom 7 (authored commitment structure yields computed consequence)
key_tensions: Realist (objective structural properties) vs Deferential (classification depends on position)
Presheaf deliberately violates sheaf gluing axiom (disagreement is diagnostic, not defect)
ε (base extractiveness) is framework's least-grounded yet most load-bearing primitive
Contentful verdicts require seats (Coupling Theorem) vs neutrality aspiration

omegas.description: OQ-205: The ε declaration discipline (provenance + stability) is owed but unbuilt as of v8.0. Without it, the framework's least-grounded primitive lacks the showing-face accountability it demands of constraints. [Note: Per 2026-07-03 annotation in source, this was BUILT after v8.0 publication with epsilon_provenance/5 carrier and stability sweep.]

The conversational two-seat hypothesis (provenance + orientation as two content-seats) was staked and lost during 2026-06 audit. Neither proposed 'seat' was a seat; orientation is a relation, provenance is the showing-face. Retired in §5.3 but the episode demonstrates the discriminator's necessity.

At v8.0 first printing, the H¹ gap spectrum was proven for n=2,3,4 real seats but general-n was open (OQ-195). The minimum nonzero disagreement is n−1; the bottom gap {1,…,n−2} widens linearly. [Note: Source indicates this is now proven for every cardinality in docs/h1_gap_spectrum_general_n.md.]
omegas.source: §3.4 Theorem 2 cardinality caveat; OQ-195 (resolved per source)

omegas.description: The narrative resleeving experiment (Stage 0-10 pipeline with enforced air gap) demonstrates constraint topology survives translation to new setting. But: does the topology survive because it is substrate-independent, or because LLMs share training-data structure? The experiment shows regeneration fidelity, not metaphysical substrate-independence.
omegas.source: §7.4; Dark Matter Probe 1 (operational medium as unexamined axis)

omegas.description: §9.3 offers the framework's repeated falsification of its authors' predictions as evidence the diagnostics track domain structure rather than analyst expectation. But: a method that falsifies predictions could be tracking noise, not structure. The claim requires showing the falsifications were *informative* (produced stronger results) not merely surprising.
omegas.source: §9.3; method-behavior record; distinction between surprise and insight

fracture_scan.notes: No fractures detected. The document is self-contained specification of an existing framework with extensive internal cross-references, version history, and implementation details. The kernel decomposition (seat/gauge/orientation as three readings of one ontological commitment) is well-supported by the audit-direction discriminator, the documented vocabulary collision, and the co-equal-meters architecture. The ε substrate dependency is flagged as a snare by the framework's own assessment (§9.2) and is independent of the ontology kernel.
